create_evaluation_data_page_from_trainin: create an EvaluationDataPage from a training batch using create_from_training_batch with a DQN or parametric DQN trainer
create_evaluation_data_page_from_seq2sla: create an EvaluationDataPage from Seq2Slate tensors using create_from_tensors_seq2slate with a ranking network and reward network
create_evaluation_data_page_from_paramet: create an EvaluationDataPage from parametric DQN tensors using create_from_tensors_parametric_dqn with states, actions, and possible actions
